description: A cheerful, traditionally styled bedroom corner with bright white walls featuring recessed applied panel moulding that runs in a grid pattern from dado to ceiling, giving a classic English country or transitional character. The headboard is a solid warm-toned medium walnut or cherry wood with a raised panel design — crisp rectangular frame construction typical of craftsman or traditional furniture. The bedding is layered with a floral print duvet cover in cream, sage, and blush tones, topped with a bold mustard yellow velvet accent pillow that pops against the white wall. A matching walnut-stained nightstand sits beside the bed, topped with a bold black-and-white ceramic hourglass-shaped vase holding a generous bouquet of white roses, white spray roses, and green filler foliage. The right wall has a floor-length dark espresso or mocha satin drape visible at the frame edge. The wall behind is crisp bright white with no surface texture beyond the raised panels. A warm amber glow emanates from the wall surface above the nightstand, illuminating the flowers and the upper portion of the nightstand richly. The color palette is bright and warm — white, walnut, mustard yellow, and fresh green — with the black vase providing a graphic anchor. Camera is at standing eye-level, normal lens, three-quarter view of the bedroom corner showing the headboard, nightstand, and wall above.
